projection.projection_goal: Provide the evaluation-expert-consumer skill with a prompt-side contract for selecting evaluation dimensions and weights so that metric selection stays bounded to mapped dimensions and weight rationales.

source_slice.slice_topic: evaluation dimension catalog and weighting rationale

constraint_mappings.notes: Selectable dimensions are restricted to the five declared names: functional_completeness, interaction_quality, process_compliance, problem_resolution, tool_call_correctness. Inventing new dimension names is forbidden.
When proposing a custom weight set, weights across selected dimensions must sum to 1.0. Default weights for the customer-service-ecommerce template are 0.25 / 0.20 / 0.20 / 0.15 / 0.20.

All selected sub-metrics MUST come from the metric_registry built by PRE step loadMetricRegistry (data layer: evaluation-expert-consumer/metrics/). Inventing sub-metrics or referencing metric_codes absent from the registry is forbidden.

Selected sub-metrics for a given test case MUST satisfy: employee.role ∈ metric.applicable_roles AND test_case.scenarios ∩ metric.applicable_scenarios ≠ ∅. STEP 2 enrichTestCases enforces this binding deterministically.

forbidden_assumptions: Do not introduce dimensions outside the declared five.
Do not propose weight sets whose sum is not 1.0.
Do not redefine baseline_score; the baseline is fixed at 50 for evidence-driven scoring.
Do not silently drop a dimension when it does not match the test case scenario; mark it as 'not applicable' with a justification instead.
required_clarifications: Clarify the employee template before finalizing weight proposals; weight ratios depend on the role's risk profile and SLA expectations.
Clarify whether the request needs the prompt-side selection policy or an enumerated metric catalog deliverable; the metric-catalog target view is the right place for the latter.
reasoning_paths: employee.role -> metric_registry.filter(applicable_roles ∋ role) -> test_case.scenarios -> metric_registry.filter(applicable_scenarios ∩ scenarios ≠ ∅) -> rank_by_relevance -> select_top_5_to_10 -> group_by(parent_dimension) -> ensure_every_dimension_has_at_least_one
source_digest: Primary source: evaluation-expert-consumer/SKILL.md (five-dimension catalog with default weights and baselines)
Supporting source: evaluation-expert-consumer/SKILL.md (built-in dimensions and weights for customer-service-ecommerce)

meta.notes: Prompt-constraint projection that bounds dimension selection and weight rationale to the declared five-dimension catalog. For an enumerated catalog deliverable (names + weights + baselines + thresholds), use the metric-catalog target view instead.
